name: amazon-ads-client-report
description: Use when someone asks for a monthly Amazon Ads report for a client, wants the Amazon section of a client deck built, needs last month's Amazon Ads performance written up, asks for an end-of-month Amazon PPC report, asks "what do I tell the client about Amazon", or asks how to present an Amazon ACOS target they missed — even when they never say the word "report". For agencies and in-house teams reporting upward. Amazon Ads only.
